prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Your companion progress and custom assets are backed up automatically to your account.", "Continue with Google", "Existing pets will sync automatically upon login."]
1: ["Matched Companion Suggestions", "Based on your quiz, here are the desktop pets that fit your workflow best."]
2: ["Your Pet Is Arriving Soon", "We are preparing your pet on your desktop. You will receive a desktop alert when ready.", "Feel free to minimize this window; we will notify you when setup finishes."]
3: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion!", "Use quick shortcuts to interact, move, or hide your pet anytime from your system tray.", "Right-click pet for actions | Double-click to talk | Drag to reposition", "Start Interacting"]
4: []
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop pet a unique name and title. These will appear on its desktop tag.", "You can change your pet's name anytime later in settings."]
6: ["How Would You Like to Pick Your Pet?", "Choose a fast preset companion or create a custom pet from scratch."]
7: ["Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet.", "Quick Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+P"]
8: ["Preparing Desktop Engine...", "Verifying display overlay permissions and pet asset rendering."]
9: ["Status: Authentication Service Active", "Stuck loading? Click below to refresh your sign-in session."]
